description: We are a team of four 7th-grade students from Class 7TA2.1 at Doan Thi Diem Secondary School: Nguyen Son Tung, Pham Gia Anh, Nguyen Khac Hoang Anh, and Le Bao Vinh. United by our shared passion for space exploration, science, and technology, we are excited to participate in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Combining our curiosity, creativity, and teamwork, we aim to tackle real-world challenges using NASA’s open data and contribute meaningful, innovative ideas to the global community.
